headline: Uzbekistan and Acwa Power Sign Carbon Market Pact at COP31 for Wind Projects
summary: Uzbekistan and Saudi Arabia's Acwa Power signed an agreement at COP31 to access international carbon markets for four wind projects generating 8.77 billion kWh annually.
why: Acwa Power is a dominant private power project operator across the Middle East and Central Asia.

impacts.name: Acwa Power
impacts.why: Firm expanded carbon trading agreements for its multi-billion dollar Uzbek wind portfolio.
